description:
The same Illinois license check as verify_license for 1 to 100 licensees in one call. Each item is a license number, or a full name plus a profession, under the same rules: no partial names, no lists. A bad item returns an error object in its own slot and is not counted; a batch with no valid item is refused and costs nothing. Use it only to verify a professional or vendor you contract with or are about to contract with. Not for employment screening of individuals, not for marketing or recruiting lists, not for profiling a person, and not for any decision covered by the Fair Credit Reporting Act.
Inputs: licensees, an array of {license_number} or {name, profession, optional city, optional zip}.
Price: $1.00 flat per call with x402. A monthly API key also works: one unit per valid item. Call coverage first (free).
Verdicts:
- active: A license was found and the state lists it as active, with no public discipline on record.
- expired: A license was found, but it has expired or was not renewed.
- inactive_or_revoked: A license was found, but it is not in force (inactive, cancelled, suspended, revoked, terminated or similar).
- disciplined: A license was found and the state has public discipline on record for it. The license may still be active: read license_active and status. The discipline block gives the most recent action's category and date, then every action's category and dates; the state's lookup page has the record.
- possible_match: More than one license fits the name and profession, or one fits but its city or ZIP does not agree with the one you sent (flag location_not_matched). candidates lists each one's profession, city and license number: check again with the license number.
- not_found: No license fits. This does not prove the person is unlicensed: see not_found_note.
Example call: {"licensees":[{"license_number":"041000000"},{"name":"Sample Roofing Co","profession":"roofing contractor"}]}
Example response: {"results":[{"verdict":"active","match":{"licensee_name":"JANE Q SAMPLE","license_number":"041000000","status":"ACTIVE"}},{"verdict":"not_found","match":null}]}

licensees.description: 1 to 100 objects, each {license_number} or {name, profession, city?, zip?}, the same fields as verify_license.

name: verify_license_batch
title: Verify up to 100 Illinois professional licenses
